goal: Extract the common abstract helper TypedValue out of Safelist into its own top-level class to reduce class size and separate concerns while preserving the Safelist API.

ops.details: Create a new top-level package-private abstract class TypedValue in org.jsoup.safety containing the constructor, the private final String value field, and implementations of hashCode(), equals(Object) and toString() that were previously the nested abstract static class TypedValue inside Safelist. Remove the nested TypedValue definition from Safelist. Keep behavior identical (use org.jsoup.helper.Validate and java.util.Objects in the new class). Inner classes TagName, AttributeKey, AttributeValue, Protocol remain nested in Safelist and will now extend the new top-level TypedValue.
Add necessary imports to TypedValue.java: import org.jsoup.helper.Validate; import java.util.Objects;. Ensure package declaration is 'package org.jsoup.safety;'.

No new external imports required in Safelist because TypedValue is in the same package; ensure Safelist compiles after removal of the nested TypedValue class (inner classes continue to extend TypedValue).

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
